snippet.title: LISA WALSER - NIMM MEINE HAND (Für Henry) (Official Video)
snippet.description:
„Nimm meine Hand“ – ein ganz besonderer Song für einen ganz besonderen Menschen 🤍

Ich habe diesen Song für meinen Mann Henry geschrieben und ihn bei unserer kirchlichen Trauung damit überrascht. Kurz vor der Trauung, nach unserem Ehegelübde, habe ich ihn für ihn gesungen. Ein Moment, den wir nie vergessen werden. Nach 11 Jahren Beziehung habe ich Henry zum ersten Mal mit Tränen in den Augen gesehen 🤍

Nachdem ich ein paar Ausschnitte auf Instagram geteilt hatte, haben mich so viele von euch gefragt, ob ich den Song veröffentlichen kann. Deshalb haben wir uns entschieden, ihn mit euch zu teilen.

Das Musikvideo bedeutet mir unglaublich viel, es ist genau dort entstanden, wo wir geheiratet haben. Ihr seht darin echte Momente unserer Hochzeit. Dieser Song ist mein Versprechen an Henry. 

Ich hoffe, dass auch ihr ein kleines Stück eurer eigenen Liebe darin wiederfindet.

Eure Lisa 🤍

snippet.title: Wolfskald - Mother Told Me | ( Official Video Music ) | Sea Shanty | Part II #seashanty #music #sea
snippet.description:
“Mother Told Me” is one of the 15 songs from Wolfskald’s sea shanty album, Echoes from the Deep.

This song is the next chapter in an ongoing cinematic story of loss, courage, loyalty, and the strength to keep moving forward.

After surviving the darkness of the sea, a warrior returns to the people she once left behind. Together, they rebuild more than a ship—they rebuild hope, purpose, and the courage to begin again. But their journey is far from over.

Inspired by the spirit of sea shanties and cinematic maritime folk music, “Mother Told Me” carries the voices, storms, memories, and determination of those who refuse to surrender to the sea.

This music video continues the story from the previous chapter, and the story will continue in future videos. Subscribe to the channel, turn on notifications, and follow Wolfskald so you don’t miss the next part.

Thank you for watching and supporting this journey.
Like, comment, share, and add the song to your playlists.

The journey continues…

Salt on my hands
Frost in my hair
I watched the dark sea
Take all I held dear

My oars were splintered
My bones were sore
Still I kept rowing
Toward the shore

Hear the drowned bell
Toll beneath the foam
Some will return
Some never come home

Hold to the rail
Hold to your name
The sea cannot drown
An undying flame

My mother told me
Daughter, stand tall
My mother told me
Storms rise and fall

My mother told me
Sing through the night
My mother told me
We’ll see dawn’s first light

Lanterns were fading
One by one
The mast was breaking
But we carried on

The old gods were silent
Cold in the spray
I gave all my fear
To the sea that day

Hear the drowned bell
Toll beneath the foam
Some will return
Some never come home

Hold to the rail
Hold to your name
The sea cannot drown
An undying flame

My mother told me
Daughter, stand tall
My mother told me
Storms rise and fall

My mother told me
Sing through the night
My mother told me
We’ll see dawn’s first light

Let the deep drums thunder
Let the ancient war cry rise
Carry the fallen’s final words
Beyond the northern skies

If I am bound to sink
I’ll face the deep with pride
With every sacred vow I made
Still burning deep inside

LUNA is a fictional virtual artist. AI-generated and AI-assisted elements are intentionally used throughout the music and visual production. No cloned or impersonated artist voices are used.

ABOUT POLYPHONIC FACE

Polyphonic Face was born from an idea I originally called “Schrödinger’s Heart.”

Sometimes we avoid an answer because, as long as we don't look, every possibility can still exist. The message remains unopened. The doors remain closed. Two futures run in parallel.

But not choosing is still a decision.

This song is about that strange space between knowing and not knowing, holding on and letting go, staying and leaving. And about the moment when we finally decide to open the message, leave the hallway and walk toward whatever comes next.
